title: Property Tax & Rent Relief
intro: For homeowners and renters — these programs lower what you owe, not just help you catch up.

programs.name: Homestead Exemption
programs.summary: Removes part of your home's value from taxation if you've owned and lived in it for at least 12 months as of April 1.
programs.know: Apply once using the city's Homestead Application — it stays in effect every year after that unless you move.

programs.name: Veteran Exemption
programs.summary: Reduces your home's taxable value. The current amount is a flat $6,000. Starting April 1, 2027, it becomes tiered by age and VA disability rating, from $5,000 up to $50,000.
programs.know: You'll need proof of service (Form DD214) with your application.

programs.name: Blind Exemption
programs.summary: Reduces your home's taxable value if you are legally blind. For Westbrook's current tax rate, this works out to about $54 a year in actual savings.
programs.know: You'll need a letter from a licensed doctor or optometrist confirming legal blindness, submitted with your application by April 1 each year.

programs.name: Property Tax Fairness Credit
programs.summary: A refundable state income tax credit if you pay a high share of your income toward rent or property tax. Claimed on Form 1040ME, Schedule PTFC — not a separate application to the City.
programs.know: Available whether or not you owe Maine income tax; any amount above what you owe is refunded to you.

programs.name: Property Tax Deferral Program
programs.summary: This is a loan, not a discount. The State pays your property tax and places a lien on your home; it's repaid with interest when you sell, move, or pass away.
programs.know: The asset limit is $100,000 for a single owner, or $150,000 for multiple owners.

programs.name: Critical Home Repair (Habitat for Humanity)
programs.summary: Labor is donated for safety repairs — structural rot, unsafe roofing or flooring, no heat or water, electrical or plumbing hazards — including accessibility modifications to help you stay in your home safely. You pay a share of the materials cost, scaled to your income.
programs.know: You must own your home (a mortgage is fine), have lived there at least 3 years, and its tax assessment can't exceed $350,000. Doesn't cover cosmetic updates, appliances, foundations, ramps, or weatherization — ask about a referral to another program for those.

programs.name: Westbrook Senior Property Tax Assistance
programs.summary: You must have lived in Westbrook at least 8 years, and have received the Property Tax Fairness Credit (above) in the prior tax year.
programs.know: Reapply every year during the enrollment window.
